rationale: ZELS is the best one-time mine for the full MK municipal buyer list and e-faktura rollout, not a continuous tender feed.
Payment-account taxonomy page is a section of ujp.gov.mk; monitor the UJP parent site instead.
Stale archived single-municipality tender page, unreachable and low yield; recheck liveness later.
EU Funding & Tenders Portal is a durable searchable procurement source covering IPA III work reaching MK institutions.
EEAS tender listing carries below-threshold EU Delegation Skopje notices published nowhere else.
EBRD corporate consultancy procurement is a standing pipeline for MK payments/financial-infrastructure advisory work.
Structured WB contract-award dataset for MK is high value but URL check failed; re-verify before approving.
WB Documents & Reports yields MK procurement plans listing PFM/IT packages ahead of any notice.
WB corporate RFX listing already carries an MK electronic-payments assignment with the central bank.
CFCD is the authoritative national IPA contracting authority; top priority but URL verification failed, re-check liveness.
Ministry of Finance notices and IT-digitalisation pages are core buyer sources; reachability unconfirmed.
SEP donor-coordination calls page is a useful pre-procurement signal hub but did not verify.
MEP IPA project listing largely duplicates SEP/CFCD content; fold into the ministry parent and re-check.
EIB TA calls cover Western Balkans digital-economy lots incl. MK; link failed verification.
UNDP procurement notices portal is a live feed of MK digital-governance and financial-inclusion tenders.
UNGM aggregates UN-system notices widely but full notice access requires registered account.
Live KfW-financed fund page publishing MK-specific calls and award notices outside the national portal.
DevelopmentAid normalises donor tenders per country but is paywalled and non-authoritative; clear access/terms first.
OCDS registry re-publishes MK procurement data in structured form enabling supplier/CPV analysis.
One-off WB regional payments-modernisation brief; valuable context evidence, not a recurring signal producer.
MBDP procurement page is the only MK bank publishing formal tenders as a contracting authority.
Secondary MBDP notices channel on the same domain; covered by monitoring the MBDP site.
MBDP reports/FOI section sits on the same monitored domain; useful FOI route but not a standalone tender source.
